verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a team chat platform, for example bulk-editing, moving or marking many messages or topics at once. The pack only documents single-item API actions (send a message), search filters, bots and organization export/import. Those are adjacent building blocks or a different (migration) capability, not a documented bulk-operation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
